node.title: Re: Getting an SSL Certificate Expiration Date
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
My understanding is that you can supply your own callback via LWP::UserAgent to do your own processing at the certificate-validation phase. That would avoid the need for a second connection. This isn't something I have done but [https://metacpan.org/dist/IO-Socket-SSL/view/lib/IO/Socket/SSL.pod#SSL_verify_callback|the docs] suggest it might be a feasible approach.

my $ua = LWP::UserAgent->new ( ssl_opts => { SSL_verify_callback => \&my_handler } );

🦛
